Fábrica abandonada y ruleta

The wheel area has a safe zone and a reported Caps trader nearby.

Actividades

Bet Scrap at the Lucky Wheel. PvP damage is disabled inside the marked safe zone.

Recompensas

A winning bet pays Scrap; a player reported a Caps trader left of the wheel.

Riesgos

A losing bet costs Scrap. PvP danger returns outside the safe-zone boundary.

Recycler

For recycling, visit a gas station, parking lot, town, warehouse, Lumberjack or Miner.
